import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # Use `{title}` and `{body}` as placeholders for the sanitized headline and text. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format and sanitize a blog entry for safe display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. text : str The full content/body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized, HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- - Uses ``html.escape`` to neutralize any potentially malicious HTML or JavaScript. - The resulting string can be safely inserted into a web page without risking Cross‑Site Scripting (CWE-79). """ # Sanitize inputs safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert sanitized content into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) return formatted_post
